podcast.title: Response to "Ohio" Release
podcast.body: Graham Nash played a key role in assembling Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young in Los Angeles to record "Ohio" after Neil Young wrote it. He later stated that when the song was released, listeners recognized that the band was speaking for them, indicating the song resonated deeply with the public. "Graham Nash later said in speaking for ourselves Listeners recognized that we were speaking for them too."
